scientific_role.role: Mechanism-specific external validation of physics-grounded blockage evidence on real 26-GHz hardware measurements.
scientific_role.supported_claim: Author-defined link-crossing trajectories produce stronger blockage-related channel evidence than trajectories that explicitly turn before blocking.
unsupported_claims: Universal superiority over all temporal models

multivariate_feature_contract.name: primary_best_rx_power_db
multivariate_feature_contract.formula: 10*log10(max over rx_beam of mean squared magnitude over the 25 symbols and 100 subcarriers for tx_layer 0)

multivariate_feature_contract.name: primary_total_power_db
multivariate_feature_contract.formula: 10*log10(mean squared magnitude over symbols, subcarriers, and rx beams for tx_layer 0)

multivariate_feature_contract.name: secondary_total_power_db
multivariate_feature_contract.formula: 10*log10(mean squared magnitude over symbols, subcarriers, and rx beams for tx_layer 1)

multivariate_feature_contract.name: primary_rx_beam_entropy
multivariate_feature_contract.formula: Normalized entropy of the eight tx_layer-0 receive-beam power shares

multivariate_feature_contract.name: primary_best_second_beam_margin_db
multivariate_feature_contract.formula: Power in dB of the strongest receive beam minus the second-strongest beam for tx_layer 0

multivariate_feature_contract.name: primary_frequency_selectivity_db
multivariate_feature_contract.formula: Standard deviation across 100 subcarriers of subcarrier power in dB, averaged over symbols and receive beams

multivariate_feature_contract.name: primary_temporal_complex_coherence
multivariate_feature_contract.formula: Mean absolute normalized complex correlation between adjacent symbols, computed across subcarriers and receive beams for tx_layer 0

multivariate_feature_contract.name: primary_rx_beam_switch_rate
multivariate_feature_contract.formula: Fraction of the 24 adjacent-symbol transitions in which the strongest receive beam changes for tx_layer 0

multivariate_feature_contract.name: primary_symbol_power_volatility_db
multivariate_feature_contract.formula: Standard deviation within the time step of symbol-level strongest-beam power in dB for tx_layer 0

primary_endpoint.name: primary_best_rx_power_excursion_db
primary_endpoint.formula: 95th percentile minus 5th percentile of primary_best_rx_power_db across the 80 time steps
primary_endpoint.selection_basis: Pre-specified physical expectation that link crossing produces a deeper within-sequence received-power change.

secondary_endpoints.name: deep_fade_occupancy_3db
secondary_endpoints.formula: Fraction of time steps whose primary_best_rx_power_db is at least 3 dB below its sequence-level 95th percentile

secondary_endpoints.name: maximum_contiguous_deep_fade_fraction
secondary_endpoints.formula: Longest contiguous run satisfying the fixed 3-dB deep-fade condition divided by 80

anti_leakage_execution_order: Decode and extract all 160 unlabeled 80-by-10 sequences.
Perform only mechanical QC: file size, shape, finite values, and feature ranges.
Freeze the complete unlabeled feature table and its SHA256 manifest.
Compute sequence-level endpoints without accessing labels.
Freeze the unlabeled endpoint table and its SHA256 manifest.
Only then join the author-defined labels from the locked Stage 59A manifest.
Run the pre-specified statistical analysis without threshold fitting or endpoint changes.

primary_discrimination_metrics: activity-level AUROC using the median of five repetitions

primary_hypothesis_test.method: Monte Carlo permutation of the 20 positive and 12 negative activity labels across 32 activity clusters

statistical_analysis.effect_size: Cliff's delta computed from the 32 activity-level median endpoint values
